args.title: Payments API errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: Payments API (payments-api) is throwing errors since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Service is unhealthy with ~18% error rate across all regions. Rolling back to v5.0.0 (last healthy release).

trace.final:
